title: Canonical open, compact-support and exceptional coefficient maps
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings in the coefficient universe, $\phi:A\to B$ a unital ring homomorphism, and work in the ordinary small-etale derived categories of module sheaves of [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write $S_T$ for the published derived scalar extension along $\phi$, the left adjoint to exact scalar restriction [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. For an open immersion $j:X\to Z$, define $o_j:(Rj_{!,A})S_Z\cong S_X(Rj_{!,B})$ (composition in diagrammatic order) as the unique comparison of composite left adjoints induced by the canonical inverse-image/scalar-restriction comparison [lem-sbc-canonical-restrict-scalars-functor-comparisons]. For a compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow{j}Z\xrightarrow{p}Y)$ of $f:X\to Y$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], put $F_{A,c}=Rp_{*,A}j_{!,A}$ and $F_{B,c}=Rp_{*,B}j_{!,B}$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. For every $M\in D(X_{et},A)$, define $b_{c,M}:S_Y(F_{A,c}M)\to F_{B,c}(S_XM)$ as the canonical proper scalar mate at $j_{!,A}M$ [lem-pur-etale-scalar-mate-projection], followed by $Rp_{*,B}$ of $o_j(M)$. Define $b^{[-1]}_{c,M}$ to be $b_{c,M}^{-1}$ when $b_{c,M}$ is an isomorphism, and the zero morphism otherwise. If $A,B$ are finite and $f$ has a chosen compactification, write $F_A\dashv G_A$ and $F_B\dashv G_B$ for the ambient compact-support/exceptional adjunctions with counits $\varepsilon_A,\varepsilon_B$ [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. For every $K\in D(Y_{et},A)$, define $\alpha_{f,K}:S_X(G_AK)\to G_B(S_YK)$ as the transpose under $F_B\dashv G_B$ of $b^{[-1]}_{c,G_AK}$ followed by $S_Y(\varepsilon_A(K))$, where $c$ is the chosen compactification of $f$. These are total definitions; no assertion that $b$ or $\alpha$ is invertible is included.

def compactSupportMap {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) :
    (scalarExtension φ Y).obj
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c).obj M) ⟶
      (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) c).obj
        ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M)
